description.content: Contains handlers for routes related to Patients.
Adjusts how we handle the act of registration of a patient.
Searches for a patient given search params.
Gets patient-specific data relevant to app state. Called on app foreground.
validates patient account credentials in cognito during registration.

Updates patient data (i.e. Athena, Cognito).
  Requires PUT operations to be idempotent.
  Sends the user an email letting them know their profile changed.
Given a patient-id, hydrate all patient data.
Given a patient id, return patient account info from Athena, Cognito and Postgres.
Update patient account info in Athena, Cognito and Postgres for a given patient id.
Updates the patient's preferred app language
Creates a patient case on athena

Given a Patient ID, fetch patient chart info.
  Gathers Allergies, Medications, and Problems
Deactivates the patient. Deletes their cognito user.
Gets patient headshot.

For a given patient-id, if a clinician has permission to join a patient's channels,
   join those channels.
Updates a patients location given state and time zone or lat/lng.
Given a patient id, fetch their default pharmacy.
Get the member's prescriptions medications details.
Given a patient id, return additional profile data.
Gets triage status for patient.
Creates manual triage status updates by providers.
Return patient vaccination status

Given a patient ID, return a boolean indicating whether the patient has had
   a video visit.
Gets a patient's visits.

List all patients and their channels to populate the messenger sidebar.
  If a prev-last-updated-at-in-ms timestamp is provided, only return channels which have
  been updated since then.
